Check whether a simulation has settled

Source: R/workflow.R
equilibrium_check.Rd

Compares the first and the second half of the recorded steps. With phylogenetic competition and high dispersal, regional exclusion can go on for thousands of steps, and the last step of such a run is not an equilibrium. A small change does not prove equilibrium either, since slow exclusion can fall below tolerance over a short record: record steps over a long stretch of the run.

Usage

equilibrium_check(x, tolerance = 0.05)

Arguments

x

An mc_sim object with history, from record_steps of simulate_metacommunity(), with at least four recorded steps.

tolerance

Largest relative change in a statistic that counts as settled.

Value

Data frame with one row for gamma, the species in all sites, alpha, the mean species per site, and abundance, the mean individuals per site, with their means in the two halves (early, late), the relative change and whether it is settled, invisibly. It gives a warning if any statistic has not settled.

Examples

set.seed(1)
tree <- treeshapesim::sim_tree_shape(15)
sim <- simulate_metacommunity(landscape_implicit(10), species_traits(tree),
                              competition_matrix(tree, "phylo"), n_steps = 200,
                              seed_steps = 1:5, record_steps = seq(100, 200, by = 10))
suppressWarnings(equilibrium_check(sim))
